'''Stasis Device''' is a tradeable.

==Summary==
'''Stasis Device''' is a [[tradeable]] that can be crafted.

==Game description==
A device specifically crafted to keep lifeforms alive for thousands of years longer than their natural lifespan. Such a device requires great skill to manufacture, as not only is it technically complex, but the consequences for a user in the event of malfunction would be disastrous.

Crafted from Quantum Processors, Cryogenic Chambers, and Iridesite.

== Source ==
The blueprint can be acquired from [[Manufacturing Facility|Manufacturing Facilites]] or purchased from the [[Synthesis Laboratory]] for 250{{Nanites}}.

[[File:Product Crafting Tree.png|thumb|Crafting tree]]
{{Craft|Quantum Processor,1;Cryogenic Chamber,1;Iridesite,1|blueprint=yes}}

==Additional information==
It is tied with the [[Fusion Ignitor]] for most valuable singular item in the game.
